nodes.name: Foundational ADRs remain Proposed
nodes.description: ADR-0043, ADR-0044, and ADR-0045 await the human L4 architecture gate; they are not yet Accepted.

nodes.name: Event fabric is in-memory
nodes.description: The typed fabric ports run in one process; the loop stops across a process boundary until bound to the canonical fact bus.

nodes.name: Durability is local-only
nodes.description: Mnemosyne's snapshot + the FactLog are single-node local files — not replicated, backed up, or transactional. Knowledge beyond the last snapshot is at risk on disk loss.

nodes.name: No live provider validation
nodes.description: The Vault Wing records validation OUTCOMES; it never calls a provider. Health reflects the manifest, not live reality.

nodes.name: @othrys-core/atlas-delivery-contract
nodes.description: The Othrys Atlas delivery contract: versioned graph schema, validation, read model, and pinned snapshot data. The package products consume.

nodes.name: othrys-capability-registry
nodes.description: Othrys Capability Registry — the canonical catalog of every external capability Othrys knows how to use. Prometheus fills it (discovery), Keymaster certifies it (Ready/Limited/Disabled), Mnemosyne preserves it (a Great Library wing). Event-driven, searchable, secret-free, provider-neutral.

nodes.name: othrys-credential-broker
nodes.description: The Credential Broker — provider credentials are held by the Bridge, never by a Titan. A Titan requests a capability and receives a restricted Provider handle; the secret stays sealed in a closure and never crosses the seam.

nodes.name: othrys-genesis
nodes.description: Genesis — the first executable vertical slice of Othrys. Composes (never invents): the Titan Runtime's Capability Registry (default-deny), the frozen Bridge pipeline, the constitutional ENFORCE pre-gate, and an append-only file Audit Ledger — to carry ONE bounded capability (echo.say) end-to-end and prove Othrys is executable, not merely specified. No new runtime, no second bus, no frozen change.

nodes.name: othrys-intelligence
nodes.description: Othrys Intelligence Foundation — the composition that makes Prometheus, Keymaster, the Capability Registry, and Mnemosyne operate as one coherent foundation over the canonical event fabric. Wires discovery -> readiness -> catalog -> preservation; adds durable boundaries, canonical health reconciliation, a website-ready read model, and the full-system exercise. No second bus; no secret leaves the v

nodes.name: othrys-keymaster
nodes.description: Keymaster — the permanent credential lifecycle authority. It owns inventory, health, incidents, remediation, policy, and opportunity — never the secret value. The Credential Broker enforces runtime access; the SecretVault stores; Keymaster governs the lifecycle above them.

nodes.name: othrys-kronos
nodes.description: Kronos — privileged platform kernel CONTRACTS only (ADR-0069). Sits above Runtime as composition-root / PID-1 authority. NOT a Titan: no titan.json; Runtime discovery must never find it. Zero business capabilities; zero provider deps; zero production deps. Boot orchestration and composition-root swap are K-05.

nodes.name: othrys-titan-runtime
nodes.description: The Titan Runtime — the self-building layer above the frozen Bridge. Auto-discovers, validates, registers, and manages self-describing Titans. A new Titan needs only: package + manifest + executors + tests.

nodes.name: othrys-talos
nodes.description: Talos — the permanent Operations Complex of Othrys, as a machine-checkable model. NOT a Titan (no titan.json; the Runtime never discovers it). Pure declarative data + invariants enforcing the org (nine departments, capability-not-vendor Workers, nine queues, the free-first ladder, the provider-selection order, and the single Great Library doorway). Provider-neutral; additive; introduces no couplin

nodes.name: othrys-triad
nodes.description: The Othrys Core Triad — the constitutional covenant of Intelligence (Prometheus), Knowledge (Mnemosyne), and Engineering (Hephaestus) as a machine-checkable model. NOT a Titan (no titan.json; the Runtime never discovers it). Pure declarative data + invariants that enforce exclusive ownership, single-source vocabulary, and graceful degradation against the real manifests. Additive; introduces no cou

nodes.name: Durable append-only FactLog
nodes.description: Append-only, replayable fact history (monotonic sequence, resumable offset). LOCAL durability only.

nodes.name: Talos FileMissionStore
nodes.description: Durable mission store for Talos (Phase 3 seam). LOCAL durability; composition-root import only.

nodes.name: Talos FileNightLedger
nodes.description: Durable Night Ledger for Talos missions (Phase 3 seam). LOCAL durability; composition-root import only.

nodes.name: Credential Broker FileUsageLedger
nodes.description: Durable CB usage ledger (write → restart → reconstruct). LOCAL durability; not re-exported from package barrels (node:fs).

nodes.name: Mnemosyne file snapshot store
nodes.description: Durable, digest-verified snapshot of Mnemosyne's library + graph. LOCAL durability only.
unknowns: local single-node durability; managed storage is the migration seam

nodes.name: Echo Titan
nodes.description: Echo — the minimal example Titan. Proves zero manual integration: it only declares a manifest + one executor; the Titan Runtime discovers, registers, and runs it with no Bridge changes.

nodes.name: Hephaestus
nodes.description: Hephaestus — Titan #2, the permanent Builder of Othrys. Stateless engineering executors + a generic durable Mission Runner (the Forge), running through the frozen Bridge/Runtime. Provider-neutral: workers are configuration, not brands.

nodes.name: Mnemosyne
nodes.description: Mnemosyne — Titan of Memory & Knowledge. Her constitutional office: she OWNS the knowledge model (evidence→knowledge→wisdom→history), the relationship vocabulary, admission policy, and retrieval semantics. She proposes, never writes canon; she never researches and never builds. Fronts the Great Library (storage, built by Hephaestus) and consumes evidence from Prometheus — all additive, provider-ne

nodes.name: Prometheus
nodes.description: Prometheus — the first Othrys Titan. Provides capabilities + executors (harvest, normalize, score) that run entirely through the frozen Bridge. Owns zero orchestration.

nodes.name: Secure SecretVault (boundary)
nodes.description: The ONLY boundary that may hold a secret value (sealed). Env adapter refuses lifecycle writes honestly. The Atlas never crosses it.
unknowns: managed backend (Vault/1Password) is future work; env-only today

nodes.name: Keymaster Vault Wing (secret-free)
nodes.description: A secret-free catalog of credential REFERENCES in the Great Library — metadata + history, never a value.
